passenger_response.subject: Your disrupted journey – AER-7P4R2M
passenger_response.body:
Dear Kenneth Braithwaite,

Our record shows that flight AK150 on 2026-08-06 was cancelled because of a nosewheel steering fault. The aircraft was withdrawn, and there was no further FCO service that day.

We have not booked you onto another flight yet. Confirming a seat is hard to undo, so we would rather you told us what suits you first. Let us know when you need to travel and we will arrange it.

On help recovering a camel-coloured overcoat left on an aircraft in March while returning from Rome: we have passed it to the team that handles it, because it is not something this desk can settle. They will pick it up from here.

We have not been able to issue you a room from our own allocation tonight. A colleague is picking this up now. Accommodation is something you are owed here, not a favour, so do not let this drop.

We cannot work out compensation yet. It depends on how late you actually arrive at your final destination, and that is not known until your new flight has run. It will be assessed then. Do not read this as a decision either way.

Regards,
Disruption Desk
